crossRefs.note: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.
translations.bsb: The disciples answered as Jesus had instructed them, and the people gave them permission.
translations.kjv: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
translations.asv: And they said unto them even as Jesus had said: and they let them go.
